items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: And all that time Weflin was encouraging me.

ctx.x: So I stayed there for most of that winter. I stayed in Minneapolis. And all that time Weflin was encouraging me. I could play In a Mist on rhumba. And he's say 'Nobody plays like that. Using four hammers, like you do. You should work on those things and write things. Develop that. Nobody's developed that technique like that.' And he said, 'Not only that, but when you play jazz, you got a touch that none of us have got.' He said, 'It's -- and you can play legato, and he said, 'I've never heard anybody legato on…
"I don't know how you do it," he said, "What do you do?"
